heard: Eliphaz, son of Esau, had a firstborn son His name was Taman, among the many listed there Omar, Zephogatam, and Kenaz followed him Chiefs descended from the mother, Adah, in the land Is there no longer wisdom in Tammuz? Counsel has perished from the prudent Their wisdom has decayed in the dust He founded a clan in the land of Adam A chief among the people known by name
